prompts.prompt: Create a highly cinematic, Hollywood-style photo of a person using the face from the uploaded image. The person is sitting calmly on a chair in the center of a large open space, looking relaxed and confident. The camera is focused on the person, who remains perfectly still and sharp. Shot with a 85mm lens at f/1.8 for dreamy bokeh, the composition follows the rule of thirds with the subject positioned dynamically against the geometric urban landscape. Captured from a low angle to enhance his commanding presence against the dramatic sky filled with wispy clouds."
